summary: CAE Inc. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report) carrying its Q2 fiscal 2027 press release and financial statements. The filing discloses an October agreement to sell Flightscape to SITA for US$500 million, expected to close in the first half of calendar 2027, with proceeds earmarked for transformation funding, core growth, and shareholder returns. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee is stated. The transaction is structural rather than market-facing; watch antitrust/regulatory clearance timing and capital deployment of proceeds.
